About the Company
This opportunity is for a Madina Specialized Center subproject focused on AI Agents and Automation Systems.

The subproject is building AI-driven solutions through a dedicated initiative centered on AI agents, automation workflows, and connected digital systems. The goal is to build practical, intelligent solutions that solve real business problems using modern AI technologies.

We are hiring 3 AI Automation Engineers to join the technical team. This is a hands-on role for people who enjoy building working systems, improving workflows, and turning ideas into practical solutions.

Job Summary
The AI Automation Engineer will support the design, development, and improvement of AI-powered systems and automation workflows.

What You Will Do

Build AI agents and intelligent automation workflows
Connect APIs, webhooks, external services, and data sources into working systems
Help develop AI-powered platforms using modern cloud tools and databases
Work with LLMs through APIs and, where needed, local model environments
Improve system performance, reliability, and technical quality
Support testing, debugging, and ongoing improvement of workflows and integrations
Research and try useful new AI tools, frameworks, and methods
Turn high-level ideas and system logic into practical working solutions
You will receive clear direction on system logic and expected outcomes. Your role is to implement efficiently and improve the technical side of the system.

Work Arrangement

Fully remote
Must have full access to interest, electiricy, computer and equipment needed to manage the tasks remotely
Job Requirements
We are looking for candidates with solid practical experience in most of the following areas:

Core Technical Requirements

Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or similar cloud platforms
Experience working with LLMs, APIs, prompt-based workflows, or agent-based systems
Ability to build or support automation platforms and workflows
Good understanding of SQL and/or NoSQL databases
Practical experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and Python
Experience with automation tools such as Make, n8n, Zapier, or similar systems
Good problem-solving, testing, and debugging skills
Basic understanding of security, access control, and safe system design
Portfolio Requirement

To apply, you must submit at least 4 real project samples related to one or more of the following:

AI agents
Automation workflows
API integrations
AI-powered bots or intelligent systems
